meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 检测并删除项目中未使用的代码：先扫描找出无用变量/导入/文件，再用 LSP 交叉验证确保不会误删，然后分派多个并行代理分批删除并逐批提交，最后运行类型检查与测试。它不会删除入口文件、被测试引用的符号等受保护代码。
howto.when: 当用户要求清理无用代码、删除死代码、清理项目，或提到“remove dead code”“cleanup”“remove unused”等关键词时触发；也可指定具体文件、目录或符号来缩小范围。

say.text: 把这个项目里的死代码清理掉。
say.note: 触发全项目扫描、验证与分批删除。

say.text: 只清理 src/hooks 目录下的未使用代码。
say.note: 将扫描范围限定在该目录。

say.text: 移除 src/utils.ts 里没被引用的那些导出。
say.note: 仅针对该文件进行死代码移除。

howto.what_en: Scans for unused files, imports, locals, and exported symbols; verifies each candidate with LSP references; batches changes by file; delegates simultaneous removal agents; runs typecheck, tests, and build. Protects entry points, test files, configs, and public symbols.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to remove dead code or unused code, or mentions "dead code", "cleanup", "remove unused", etc. Can be narrowed to a specific file, directory, or symbol.

say_en.text: Remove dead code from this project.
say_en.note: Runs full scan, verification, and parallel removal.

say_en.text: Clean up unused code in src/hooks only.
say_en.note: Limits the scan to that directory.
